subject: Initial workspace access & API key gateway
messages:
From: Jordan Miles <jordan.miles@storifyhealth.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-14T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Storify: org access kickoff / API key gating

Hi Tessa + Monica,

Thanks again for the demo earlier — Storify is ready to start the initial workspace/tenant setup. Our goals for week 1: get a staging workspace active, seed a small set of API keys for integration testing, and confirm a secure path for production key issuance.

Quick asks to kick off:
- Can you confirm recommended project/namespace naming convention for our org?
- We need a short mutual action plan (MAP) outlining who will create projects, who seeds keys, and who approves prod keys.
- Any templates for provisioning matrices or role mappings would help.

Attaching a short PDF with our compliance point-of-contact and initial network allowlist. Happy to set a 30-minute handoff tomorrow (Tue) if that works.

Thanks,
Jordan Miles
Head of Integrations, Storify Health
(jordan.miles@storifyhealth.com)

Attachment: storify_onboarding_MAT.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Miles <jordan.miles@storifyhealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-14T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Storify: org access kickoff / API key gating

Jordan — great to hear.

Short answers up front:
- Naming: use storify-prod / storify-staging as top-level namespaces; project names like storify-prod-api and storify-staging-integ. We can seed those for you during the handoff.
- MAP: I'll propose a lightweight plan below and attach a provisioning_matrix.xlsx you can edit.

Proposed MAP (week 1):
1) Redwood creates staging workspace and project namespaces (we'll provision roles: Admin, Dev, Read-only).
2) Storify confirms list of users (emails) for Admin/Dev invites.
3) Redwood seeds two staging API keys (long-lived for now), with scoped roles.
4) Integration tests run by Storify.
5) Once QA signoff, Storify requests prod key issuance via our ticket and we provide managed prod keys and rotation schedule.

Security notes: we recommend service accounts for server-to-server calls, and ephemeral keys for client flows. Grace — can you add the recommended key TTLs and rotation plan to the attached sheet?

If that all looks good, can we do a 09:00 PT handoff tomorrow?

—Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
T: +1 415 555 0192

Attachment: provisioning_matrix.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Miles <jordan.miles@storifyhealth.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-15T08:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Storify: org access kickoff / API key gating

Jordan / Tessa — quick technical handoff notes before the call: 
- We'll create two projects in your staging namespace: storify-staging-integ and storify-staging-sandbox. Each will have its own service-account identity.
- Admin role includes: invite users, create service accounts, rotate keys. Dev role includes deploy and view logs. Read-only is self-explanatory.
- For API keys we support: 
  * long-lived service keys (rotated monthly)
  * short-lived ephemeral tokens (recommended for browser client flows)

Dev — can you prepare the onboarding script that will: create projects, seed two staging keys, and output a CSV with key_id and a masked key sample? We'll need Storify to provide the initial admin user list for invites.

Jordan — please share the three emails we should invite as Admins and the preferred service-account naming (we usually recommend storify-svc-{env}).

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Implementation Lead, Redwood Inference

--

Thanks — I'll run the provisioning script tomorrow morning (UTC) and post the results to the ticket. Checklist I'm going to execute: 
1) Create namespaces: storify-staging, storify-prod (meta-only until you request prod keys).
2) Create projects: storify-staging-integ, storify-staging-sandbox.
3) Create service account: storify-svc-staging and grant Dev + Admin roles.
4) Seed two staging keys and write a CSV to a secure drive link.
5) Add key rotation metadata (rotation_window: 30d) and TTL for ephemeral tokens (15m).

I need 3 things from Storify to proceed:
- Admin invite list (3 emails)
- Preferred service-account shortname (we default to storify-svc-staging)
- Any IP allowlist we should apply to staging keys

Once done I'll attach the CSV (keys masked) and the terraform snippet we ran.

—Dev
Dev Patel
Platform Engineer, Redwood Inference
